ENGLISH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.

   A. No full stops

   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

   A. happiness
   B. quickly
   C. blue
   D. run
